answer: Only count a grader's votes if it takes the seats it's handed, not just the ones it likes. Over its last 20 epochs an account has to seal at least 60% of the seats offered to it, or its grades count for nothing that epoch and its seats go to someone else. A farm wants to sit only on its own members' answers, say scoring a sibling's sonnet about opal a 3 while letting every stranger's horizon survey expire. Now each fake account has to grade the strangers' work too, well enough to keep matching verdicts, so every clone costs real hours.
